page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the right margin (upper group and lower group, the lower one partly in Arabic). Running head "NOTÆ." above the text, page number 333 at top right.

main_text.l: AlWafilah peculiariter ex ovibus, quod (sc. cum parerent
ovis fœmellam, [illegible, ~6 letters] cam sibi haberent, cum vero masculam
[illegible, ~8 letters] eum Diis suis consecrarent,
quod si simul masculum & fœminam, dicerent, conjunctas
fratri suo, nec marem istum diis suis sacrificarent; aut
si ea ovis quæ primo marem parit, deinde fœminam,
ut quòd fratrem suum proximè sequeretur, in causa
esset ne ipsum jugularent, quòd si marem parerent, dicerent,
sit hic diis nostris oblatio. Hæc ille, ab Al Jauharío
diversus, qui dicit, Si ovis septies continuis vicibus
gemellas peperisset, deinde vice octava [illegible, ~6 letters] masculum, eum
ipsos Diis suis sacrificasse, sin [illegible, ~8 letters] masculum &
fœminam, dicere solitos [illegible, ~6 letters] Fratri suo
conjuncta est, atque ejus gratiâ mari parcere, matris autem
ac non bibere fœminas, &c. Juxta Authorem lib.
Nozhrat Dorri, AlWafilah erat ovis, quæ cum septies
peperisset, quod septimo pareret, si mas esset in sacrificium
cedebat, sin fœmina, dimittebatur fœminarum usui concessa,
sin mas & fœmina dicerent [illegible, ~8 letters] utrosque
eros habentes, ut ex iis utilitatem caperet, fœmellaque
ne bibere viris[?] solis permitteretur. At describente
Al Motarrezio, Ovis quæ decem fœmellas quinis partubus
continuis ederet, sc. singulis vicibus gemellas, & si quid
appareret[?], viris cederet, non fœminis, &c.
Supereft [illegible, ~5 letters] AlHami, qui (explicante Al-
Firauzabadio est Camelus admissarius, ex quo cum toties
decies puta) conceperint fœmina postea dicitur AlHami,
id. cujus dorsum immune factum est, utpote qui
dimitteretur ut ex eo utilitatem amplius capere non [?]i-
ceret, quique ab aqua aut pascuo non arceretur, [illegible,
~9 letters] nec infidari soleret nec ton-
deri,

marginalia.note: [illegible, ~6 letters] qui natos natorum viderit. Ali aohar. & Nozhroi'dorri.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Arabic throughout is largely illegible on the scan and is marked as such rather than guessed. Words at the left edge are partly cut off ("iceret", "virus/viris", "appareret"), so those letters are uncertain. "AlWafilah" and "AlHami" are name spellings I could not confirm. The page ends mid-sentence ("tonderi,"); the text continues on the next page. No catchword or signature is visible.
